metadata.title: Beijing Parkour
metadata.titleAlt: 北京跑酷 · 熊猫跳跳
metadata.pegi: PEGI 7 / everyone — no violence, no ads in Basic Launch
metadata.shortDescription: Papercraft 3D panda parkour from Tiananmen Square to the Bird's Nest. All art is generated in code.
metadata.longDescription: Play as a papercraft panda and run north through Beijing: Tiananmen, hutong rooftops, lantern alleys, the Temple of Heaven, CBD skyscrapers, the Water Cube, and finally the Bird's Nest. Collect coins, hit checkpoints, double-jump across moving lantern bridges — fall onto the street and you respawn. Built with three.js; every mesh, texture, and sound is procedural. No downloads.
metadata.instructions: WASD / Arrow keys: move. Space: jump (tap again in air for a double jump). Q / E: rotate camera. R: respawn at last checkpoint (or restart after winning). Press any key on the title card to start.
